title: Several active tasks at once: per-task state files .claude/state/tasks/<TASK>.json, Task-trailer gates, file-scope overlap check at pick, hooks/status for all active tasks, per-task role guard, pending-question record + 10-min reminder [RAW-00482; reuse TASK-080 80.5 code in 8793e80]
requirement: WHEN the coordinator picks a task while another task is active, the workflow SHALL keep each active task's state in its own file (.claude/state/tasks/<TASK>.json), and gates, hooks and commits SHALL act on the task named in the commit Task: trailer. REQ-0060
acceptance_criteria: AC1 up to N active tasks, own files, task.json view
AC2 gates keyed by Task: trailer, one task per commit
AC3 scope overlap serialized with blocked_by; B2 block
AC4 hooks/status show all active tasks
AC8 protocol import, small main context
AC6 tests with two active tasks
AC10 decisions before start; no mid-task block
AC11 configurable N, hold/resume with checkpoint

design.summary: per-task task.<T>.json + task.json view, N<=3 active, Task-trailer gates, scope overlap -> blocked_by queue, guard B1/B2 blocks, pending questions, tasks.sh status for main context, input-hash stale check; protocol import table

implementation.summary: three slices: per-task state core (_tasks.py, tasks.sh, backlog/workflow-check/commit-check/readers), pending questions + status + hold/resume + stale inputs + reader inventory + questions gate + 96.18 hardening, guard B1/B2 + ask-once checkpoint + multi-task hooks (patches applied by the user), docs, migration

unit_test.command: env -u TASK -u CTXGUARD_TASK bash .claude/tests/<suite>_test.sh (all 12); checks/shell.sh; checks/task_readers.sh; tests/run_all.sh
unit_test.result: 12 .claude suites 0 fail (multi_task 128, multi_guard 38, workflow_gates 146, task_checkpoint 38); task_readers fail=0; shell 1 known (untracked tmp/); run_all 144 suites, only ext_scan_test (F-96-1, TASK-095, queued on TASK-078); evidence work/TASK-096/evidence/qa-96-final-*

security.result: B1/B2 block cross-task writes, quote-stripped (multi_guard 87-88). Residual: Bash write detection is a verb regex (misses cd+relative, python -c, variables, symlinks); a role with no launch match self-binds by its first work/TASK-x write; agent_setup_binds.json is gitignored runtime and not write-protected for roles (protecting it is a new block, needs the user). No secrets or REPOS_ROOT reads added.

verification.command: Argus review of AC1-AC12 vs evidence; main: git diff --name-only 3697c02..HEAD, protect diff
verification.result: PASS: AC1-AC12 evidenced (AC8/AC10 by docs review); only approved blocks B1/B2/ask-once; protect diff = one narrowing (save|load removed); out-of-scope task_gate.py added to scope (F-V96-1); code unchanged since QA evidence 076b92b (only state/req files after)

crosscheck.waiver: workflow tooling only: no finding counts, report data or run decisions to cross-check; tester AC map (test.md) and verifier (verify.md) are the independent checks
